source.description: Carries each package's source hash to its dependents, so a check reruns when a package it loads changes, without waiting for that package's checks.

typecheck.description: The dev tools' tsconfig bases, which the root tsconfig and every Effect-free package extend, are inputs too.

superlint.description: The dev tools' rules and the superlint options in the root package.json are inputs too.

oxlint.description: The dev tools' preset and plugin are inputs too.

//#architecture.description: fallow's cycles, boundaries and policy rules, which dead-code reports too until fallow's next major drops them from it.

//#dedupe.description: The lockfile is already deduplicated: pnpm dedupe would change nothing.

test.description: Every test. Each run draws fresh rotating seeds, so a test never replays from cache; the run's seed, a replay and a fuzz run come through the environment.

corpus.description: Generates every pinned corpus specification and compares each verdict byte for byte: it reads the pinned specifications from the cache, so it never caches.
